description:
The Vamoose TORO packs a punch with a BAFANG M430 500W mid-drive motor, Samsung 48V 15Ah UL-certified battery, and Bafang color display with Bluetooth. Ride smooth with a 140mm RST air fork, Shimano 11-speed drivetrain, and Tektro hydraulic brakes. With trail-ready Maxxis Recon tires, a KS dropper post, and premium components throughout, it’s built for performance on any terrain.Built for Power. Designed for Control.Meet the ultimate ride for riders who demand performance, comfort, and modern design. The VAMOOSE TORO features a rugged 6061 aluminum hardtail frame with internal cable routing and a seamlessly integrated UL-certified downtube battery. At its heart, the BAFANG M430 48V 500W mid-drive motor delivers smooth, intelligent power — all displayed on a vibrant Bafang C245 color display with Bluetooth connectivity.

Tackle trails with confidence thanks to the RST VIBE air fork (140mm travel) and Maxxis Recon 27.5x2.8" tires. Stay in full control with Tektro HD3520 hydraulic brakes, and shift effortlessly through the Shimano CUES 11-speed (11-50T) drivetrain.

Packed with top-tier components like a KS dropper post, Promax cockpit, and a DDK performance saddle, this e-bike is engineered for serious adventure, whether you're cruising city paths or tearing up singletrack.
This cycle comes standard with the following adders:

• BAFANG M430 48v 500w mid drive motor
• 140Nm torque

• UL Certified 48v 15ah Samsung with 5000mah cells

• A 6061 aircraft aluminum frame with a RST 27.5inch VIBE air fork and thru axle

• Torque sensor

• Hydraulic Tektro HD3520 hydraulic dual piston brakes

• Front MAXXIS Recon 27.5x2.8" front and rear tires

• Dropper seat post (170mm)

• Thumb Throttle
